scientific_conclusion: The Stage-110 association is strongly axis-conditioned. For the common map, x-axis relative asymmetry has Spearman 0.8169117257050571 and an upper/lower severity-quartile mean growth-amplitude ratio of 3.336300239702585, while y gives Spearman -0.029940873742411493 and ratio 1.32820989390207. The same pattern is independently present in phi (x Spearman 0.6524774835634927, ratio 2.4717982930851448) and psi (x Spearman 0.8891624384217938, ratio 4.537659855888967). Because the x share of raw same-sign change is only 0.4572198903621674 for phi and 0.48532122032708375 for psi, the result is not simple x-magnitude dominance. The preregistered next step is a fixed Stage-112 x-axis-specific spatial localization audit, without solver reruns or retuning.
